title: Academics | Adkins Preparatory School
description: Explore Adkins Preparatory School's curriculum for Lower Primary and Upper Primary learners.

hero.heading: Learning with purpose and joy
hero.description: Our curriculum is designed to challenge every learner, celebrate individual growth, and develop the confidence and character children need to thrive.

intro.heading: Two stages, continuous growth
intro.text: Lower Primary focuses on foundational literacy, numeracy, confidence, and love of learning. Upper Primary deepens knowledge, builds independence, develops critical thinking, and nurtures responsibility.
